question: Which state was ranked the best-performing in the Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE) 2020–2025 of National Parks and Protected Areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE)** is a global framework used to assess how well **National Parks** and **Wildlife Sanctuaries** are being managed. In the **2022–23** cycle (the 5th cycle relevant to the 2020–2025 period), **Kerala** emerged as the top-performing state.
 
• The **Periyar Tiger Reserve** in **Kerala** was ranked as the best-managed protected area in the country, securing an exceptional **MEE score of 94.38%**. ***Hence, the statement regarding Kerala being the best performer is correct.***
 
• This evaluation was conducted by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** in collaboration with the **Wildlife Institute of India (WII)** and the **National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)**.
 
• The evaluation process involves **30 parameters** categorized under planning, inputs, process, outputs, and outcomes to ensure a comprehensive assessment of **biodiversity conservation** and administrative efficiency.
 
• The **MEE 2022–2023** report highlighted that **Kerala** has consistently maintained high standards in **habitat management**, **anti-poaching measures**, and **community participation** in conservation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Periyar Tiger Reserve (Kerala):**
 
 
• Located in the **Idukki** and **Pathanamthitta** districts within the **Western Ghats**.
 
• It was declared a **National Park** in **1982** and is famous for its **Asian Elephant** and **Bengal Tiger** populations.
 
• The reserve is notable for the **Periyar Lake**, an artificial reservoir formed by the **Mullaperiyar Dam** across the **Periyar River**.
 
 
 
• **Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE) Framework:**
 
 
• The framework was originally developed by the **IUCN World Commission on Protected Areas (WCPA)**.
 
• India adopted this system in **2006** to bring transparency and scientific rigor to the management of its **Protected Area (PA) network**.
 
• Protected areas are categorized into four groups: **Very Good** (score > 75%), **Good** (60-74%), **Satisfactory** (50-59%), and **Poor** (
 
 
• **Other High Performing States and Reserves:**
 
 
• Following **Kerala**, states like **Madhya Pradesh** and **Karnataka** also showed strong performance.
 
• **Satpura Tiger Reserve** (Madhya Pradesh) and **Bandipur Tiger Reserve** (Karnataka) were among the other top-ranked sites in recent **MEE** cycles.
 
• In **Tamil Nadu**, the **Anamalai Tiger Reserve** and **Mudumalai Tiger Reserve** also featured in the "Very Good" category.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Significance:**
 
 
• As of **2023**, India has over **990 Protected Areas**, including **106 National Parks** and **567 Wildlife Sanctuaries**.
 
• These evaluations are critical for the **Project Tiger** and **Project Elephant** initiatives to identify gaps in **corridor management** and **man-animal conflict** mitigation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Year of Report Release:** The 5th cycle report was released in **April 2023** by the **Prime Minister** during the celebration of **50 years of Project Tiger** in **Mysuru**.
 
• **Statistical Data:** Out of the tiger reserves evaluated, **12** were ranked in the **'Excellent'** category, while **Kerala's Periyar** remained at the absolute pinnacle.
 
• **Legal Framework:** All protected areas in India are governed under the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**, which provides the legal basis for the establishment and management of these zones.

b1:T
